[[File:Magic Instructor chathead.png|left]]
'''Terrova''', the '''Magic instructor''', is the last instructor new players meet on [[Tutorial Island]]. He teaches players about [[Magic]] and how to cast spells, and provided them with 5 [[air rune]]s and 5 [[mind rune]]s.

The Magic instructor is found in the building at the end of the dirt road on [[Tutorial Island]]. He has a large cage with [[Chicken (Tutorial Island)|chickens]] in it for players to train with the [[runes]] he provides to them (you could only use [[ranged]] or magic attacks on the chickens because the cage is only made of walls and a metal fence, which doesn't have a gate).
